vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you do every evening before bed
vocabulary.example: My night routine is simple.

vocabulary.meaning_en: normal; what happens most times
vocabulary.example: It was the usual day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: relax after work or stress
vocabulary.example: I read a book to unwind.

vocabulary.meaning_en: washing your body under hot water
vocabulary.example: A hot shower helps me sleep.

vocabulary.meaning_en: comfortable (informal)
vocabulary.example: I wear comfy clothes at home.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one part of a TV series
vocabulary.example: I watch one episode every night.

vocabulary.meaning_en: like something very much (informal)
vocabulary.example: I'm really into history books.

vocabulary.meaning_en: keep two things apart
vocabulary.example: I separate my work life from my home life.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea or opinion
vocabulary.note_ar: That's a good point = هذه فكرة صحيحة
vocabulary.note_en: That's a good point = you are right
vocabulary.example: That's a good point.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that takes your mind away from your problems
vocabulary.example: A walk is a good distraction.

vocabulary.meaning_en: reports about what is happening in the world
vocabulary.example: My father watches the news at eight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a talk or show you listen to on the internet
vocabulary.example: I listen to a podcast about science.

vocabulary.meaning_en: talk with someone about recent news
vocabulary.example: I call my cousin to catch up.

vocabulary.meaning_en: move up or down on a phone screen
vocabulary.example: Don't scroll through your phone at night.

vocabulary.meaning_en: websites and apps for sharing with people
vocabulary.example: I spend too much time on social media.

vocabulary.meaning_en: too much to deal with
vocabulary.example: So much news can be overwhelming.

vocabulary.meaning_en: stop using phones and the internet for a time
vocabulary.example: I disconnect for an hour every evening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: great happiness
vocabulary.example: Reading brings me joy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the health of your mind and feelings
vocabulary.example: Sleep is good for your mental health.

vocabulary.meaning_en: things you do to look after your own health
vocabulary.example: Self-care is important after a long day.

fine_lines.title: relax vs unwind
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى متقارب: الاسترخاء. unwind تُستخدم خصوصًا بعد يوم عمل متعب أو ضغط.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean rest. "Unwind" is used especially after work or stress.

examples.sentence: I need to unwind after work.

fine_lines.title: comfortable vs comfy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: comfy هي الصيغة غير الرسمية من comfortable.

expressions.phrase: How was your day? — It was good, thanks.
expressions.meaning_ar: كيف كان يومك؟ — كان جيدًا، شكرًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Ask and answer about someone's day.
expressions.example: How was your day? It was good, thanks.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you understand because the same happens to you.
expressions.example: I'm tired after work. I know the feeling.

expressions.phrase: What do you usually do to unwind after work?
expressions.meaning_ar: ماذا تفعل عادةً لتسترخي بعد العمل؟
expressions.example: What do you usually do to unwind after work? I read.
Sleep is important. That's a good point.

expressions.phrase: It's important to have some time to unwind.
expressions.meaning_ar: من المهم أن يكون لديك وقت للاسترخاء.
expressions.example: Work is busy, but it's important to have some time to unwind.

expressions.phrase: Or I'll call a friend and catch up.
expressions.example: Sometimes I'll call a friend and catch up.

expressions.meaning_ar: من المهم أن تبتعد عن الأجهزة.
expressions.example: Put your phone away. It's important to disconnect.

expressions.meaning_en: Thank someone for helping with an idea.

grammar.title: Present simple with "usually" for habits
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط مع usually للعادات: I usually watch the news. وفي السؤال: What do you usually do? (usually بعد الفاعل وقبل الفعل).
grammar.explanation_en: Present simple + usually for habits. Usually goes before the main verb.
examples: What do you usually do after work?
I usually call my mother in the evening.

grammar.title: "It's important to + verb" for advice
grammar.explanation_ar: لنقدّم نصيحة عامة: It's important to + الفعل في أصله: It's important to disconnect.
grammar.explanation_en: Give advice with It's important to + base verb.
examples: It's important to have time to unwind.

grammar.title: "I like to" + verb / "I find that..."
grammar.explanation_ar: I like to + الفعل للعادات المحبوبة: I like to take a hot shower. و I find that... تعني لاحظت من تجربتي أن...
grammar.explanation_en: I like to + verb for things you enjoy. I find that... = from my experience...
examples: I like to take a hot shower.
I find that reading helps me relax.
I like to put on comfy clothes.

questions.question: What do you usually do to ___ after work?
How was your day? — It ___ good, thanks.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال بالماضي was، فالجواب It was.
questions.explanation_en: The question is past, so: It was.

questions.question: I'm tired after work. — I know the ___.
questions.explanation_en: The phrase is "I know the feeling".

questions.question: It's important ___ and do something you enjoy.
One part of a TV series is an ___.
questions.explanation_en: An episode is one part of a series.

questions.question: I ___ watch the news. (= most days)
questions.explanation_en: The adverb "usually" goes before the verb.

questions.question: Too much social media can be ___.
Taking care of your own health is called ___.
Sometimes I call a friend and ___.
questions.explanation_en: "Catch up" means talk about recent news.
